observed_contract_notes: tool hooks carry session_id and tool_use_id
PreToolUse and canUseTool can mediate a tool before execution
PostToolUse and PostToolUseFailure report completion paths
query resume accepts a session ID and SessionStart distinguishes resume
Query.interrupt returns an optional receipt only when the runtime advertises the matching capability
result modelUsage is cumulative and excludes some helper calls, so strict usage completeness is not established by types alone
